# reolink_ai_detection (Resource)

Manages one Reolink smart-detection class using GetAiAlarm and SetAiAlarm.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "reolink_ai_detection" "people" {
  camera      = "front"
  channel     = 0
  type        = "people"
  sensitivity = 60
  delay       = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `camera` (String) Key in the provider cameras map.
- `sensitivity` (Number) Camera-native AI sensitivity from 0 to 100.
- `type` (String) Detection class: people, vehicle, dog_cat, or face.

### Optional

- `channel` (Number) Zero-based camera channel. Defaults to 0.
- `delay` (Number) Camera-native alarm delay from 0 to 8. Defaults to 0.
- `maximum_height` (Number) Normalized maximum target height.
- `maximum_width` (Number) Normalized maximum target width.
- `minimum_height` (Number) Normalized minimum target height.
- `minimum_width` (Number) Normalized minimum target width.
- `scope` (String) Camera-native AI detection mask bit string.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

terraform import reolink_ai_detection.people front/0/people
```
